workflows.name: Launching Applications
workflows.description: Open the apps you use most without reaching for the mouse.

steps.heading: Launch a Terminal
steps.description: Opens your terminal. This is the shortcut you will use more than any other.

steps.heading: Launch a Browser
steps.description: Opens your default browser, tiled beside the terminal.

steps.heading: Application Launcher
steps.description: Search and start any installed application by name.

steps.heading: Keybinding Viewer
steps.description: Shows every shortcut available. Your reference when you forget one.
